scripts.db:reset: npm run db:down && npm run db:up && npm run migrate
scripts.dev: cross-env API_PORT=3105 WEB_PORT=5105 DATABASE_URL=postgres://auction:auction@localhost:55432/auction_part_5 REDIS_URL=redis://127.0.0.1:56379 concurrently -k -n server,web "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace web"
